props.text: Resource Timeline demo — data is seeded relative to TODAY on view load. Drag a bar to retime, drag it onto another row to reassign, drag an edge to resize, drag empty track to create. Bars marked ↻ are recurring (drag/edit one detaches that occurrence). Try the Live toggle: the window follows the now-line; paging disarms it. Every change persists via one onChange script.

transforms.code:
# Evergreen demo data seeded relative to today (now(0) = once per view load,
	# so in-session edits stick). Bars, state bands and background bands.
	d0 = system.date.midnight(value)
	def at(n, h, m=0):
		return system.date.addMinutes(system.date.addHours(system.date.addDays(d0, n), h), m)
	def iso(d):
		return system.date.format(d, "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss")
	out = []
	def ev(eid, res, title, s, e, cat, **kw):
		row = {"id": eid, "resourceId": res, "title": title, "start": s, "category": cat}
		if e:
			row["end"] = e
		row.update(kw)
		out.append(row)
	ev("j1", "mixer1", "Batch 4711", iso(at(0, 6)), iso(at(0, 10)), "prod")
	ev("j2", "mixer1", "Batch 4712", iso(at(0, 10, 30)), iso(at(0, 14)), "prod")
	ev("j3", "mixer2", "Batch 4713", iso(at(0, 7)), iso(at(0, 12)), "prod")
	ev("j4", "mixer2", "Rush order", iso(at(0, 9)), iso(at(0, 11)), "prod", status="tentative",
		description="Overlaps Batch 4713 - the two pack into stacked lanes.")
	ev("j5", "filler1", "CIP clean", iso(at(0, 5)), iso(at(0, 7, 30)), "maint")
	ev("j6", "filler1", "Fill run A", iso(at(0, 8)), iso(at(0, 16)), "prod")
	ev("j7", "packer1", "Order 981 (no end)", iso(at(0, 13)), None, "prod",
		description="Open-ended - the bar runs to the window edge.")
	ev("j8", "packer2", "Cancelled run", iso(at(0, 6)), iso(at(0, 9)), "prod", status="cancelled")
	ev("j9", "packer2", "Long changeover", iso(at(-1, 20)), iso(at(0, 5)), "maint",
		description="Started yesterday evening - shows the continues-left chevron.")
	ev("s1", "mixer2", "RUNNING", iso(at(0, 0)), iso(at(0, 4)), "prod", display="state")
	ev("s2", "mixer2", "FAULT", iso(at(0, 4)), iso(at(0, 5, 30)), "down", display="state")
	ev("s3", "mixer2", "RUNNING (ongoing)", iso(at(0, 5, 30)), None, "prod", display="state")
	ev("bg1", "packer1", "Planned maintenance window", iso(at(0, 2)), iso(at(0, 5)), "maint",
		display="background")
	ev("bg2", "packer2", "Planned maintenance window", iso(at(0, 2)), iso(at(0, 5)), "maint",
		display="background")
	return out
